options.text_cn: 车和马配合，将死角落的王
options.text_en: A rook and knight work together to checkmate a king in the corner

options.text_cn: 两个象从两条交叉对角线同时攻击王，将死对方
options.text_en: Two bishops attack the king along crossing diagonals and deliver checkmate

options.text_cn: 后在对角线将死被己方棋子封住的王
options.text_en: A queen checkmates a king trapped by its own pieces along a diagonal

options.text_cn: 双车并列将死底线的王
options.text_en: Two rooks line up to checkmate a king on the back rank

explanation_cn: 博登杀的特征是两个象分别站在两条不同颜色的对角线上，交叉攻击对方的王，使其无处可逃。通常发生在王的逃格被己方棋子封住的情况下。
explanation_en: Boden's mate features two bishops on opposite-colored squares attacking the king along crossing diagonals, leaving it with no escape. The pattern often works because the king's own pieces block its escape squares.
